content.characters.octarine.name: Florist
content.characters.octarine.passive: Abilities and items have 12% shorter cooldowns.
content.characters.octarine.growth: Cooldown is reduced by another 0.5% per level.
content.characters.swordsman.name: Swordsman
content.characters.swordsman.passive: Gains armor at every level and has a 18.5% chance to block a physical contact attack.
content.characters.swordsman.growth: +0.5 percentage points of armor and +0.65 percentage points of block chance per level.
content.characters.smith.name: Smith
content.characters.goflin.name: Goflin
content.characters.goflin.passive: Gains 25% more gold. Each coin in the wallet adds 0.1 damage.
content.characters.celestial_mage.name: Celestial Mage
content.characters.celestial_mage.passiv: Deals 35% more magic damage and has 50% less maximum health.
content.characters.watchman.name: Watchman
content.characters.watchman.passive: Gains 0.75 damage for each minute on the run clock.
content.characters.watchman.growth: +1.05 percentage point of critical hit chance per level.
content.characters.nekochan.name: Neko-chan
content.characters.nekochan.passive: Allies within 175 take 10% less damage and regenerate 1.75 HP per second. Neko-chan gets these bonuses ×1.75.
content.characters.nekochan.growth: +0.35 percentage points of damage reduction, +1.5 radius and +0.35 HP/s per level.
content.items.sneakers.name: Sneakers
content.items.sprats.name: Tin of Sprats
content.items.chocolate.name: Chocolate
content.items.snack_bar.name: Snack Bar
content.items.expander.name: Expander
content.items.expander.description: +20% radius for all items and weapons.
content.items.heavy_shackles.name: Heavy Shackles
content.items.fork.name: Fork
content.items.fork.description: +44 percentage points of physical critical chance.
content.items.needle.name: Needle
content.items.bloodstone.name: Bloodstone
content.items.bloodstone.description: +33 percentage points of magical critical chance and +10 percentage points of magical lifesteal.
content.items.sentient_grass.name: Sentient Grass
content.items.sentient_grass.description: Standing still restores 2.25% of maximum health per second.
content.items.grandmas_compote.name: Grandma's Compote
content.items.grandmas_compote.descripti: Grants a shield for 15% of maximum health. Recharges after 4 seconds without taking damage.
content.items.star_of_david.name: Star of David
content.items.hyena_tooth.name: Hyena Tooth
content.items.hyena_tooth.description: On pickup, grants 120 XP per 3 minutes on the run clock.
content.items.whoopee_cushion.name: Whoopee Cushion
content.items.whoopee_cushion.descriptio: After dodging, gain 5% movement speed for 3 seconds.
content.items.garlic.name: Garlic
content.items.shield.name: Shield
content.items.shield.description: Blocks one physical attack every 12 seconds.
content.items.dice.name: Dice
content.items.dice.description: 25% chance to change outgoing damage to a different type.
content.items.finisher.name: Finisher
content.items.finisher.description: 50% chance to execute a non-boss enemy when a hit drops it below 12% health.
content.items.nettle.name: Nettle
content.items.nettle.description: Reflects 18% of damage taken from enemies as pure damage.
content.items.sword.name: Sword
content.items.sword.description: Deals 15 physical damage in a 120-degree forward cone every 1.5 seconds.
content.items.laser.name: Laser
content.items.laser.description: Instantly kills up to two non-boss enemies every 8.5 seconds.
content.items.galactic_rifle.name: Galactic Rifle
content.items.galactic_rifle.description: Every 16 seconds, hits the enemy with the most current health for 20% of its current health (8% for bosses) as physical damage.
content.items.accelerator.name: Accelerator
content.items.accelerator.description: Every 27.18 seconds, gain 25% movement speed for 3.14 seconds and deal 16.1 physical damage on contact with enemies.
content.items.garden_gnome.name: Garden Gnome
content.items.garden_gnome.description: Every 7 seconds, summons a gnome with 85 HP. It deals 10 physical damage. Up to two gnomes per copy of the item.
content.items.sausages.name: Sausages
content.items.sausages.description: A friendly dog fetches XP within 1000.
content.items.fpv_drone.name: FPV Drone
content.items.fpv_drone.description: The drone flies into an enemy, explodes for 45 physical damage in radius 115, and respawns after 8 seconds.
content.items.bait.name: Bait
content.items.bait.description: Every 5 seconds, summons a 85 HP boar. Its poison spits for 20 magical damage and slows by 18% in radius 75.
content.items.death_eagle.name: Death Eagle
content.items.death_eagle.description: Every 8 seconds, the eagle dives at a random enemy for 50 physical damage and a 0.8-second stun in radius 150.
content.items.leech.name: Leech
content.items.leech.description: Every 50 seconds, summons a creature that transfers its 100 HP to you at 5 HP per second.
content.items.satanic_bible.name: Satanic Bible
content.items.satanic_bible.description: Hits have a 32% chance to turn a non-boss enemy into an allied demon. Demons live 6 seconds and deal 22 pure damage twice per second.
content.items.wooden_stick.name: Wooden Stick
content.items.wooden_stick.description: Every 5 seconds, deals 29 to 40 pure damage and slows enemies by 10-25% within radius 350. Both effects are stronger near you.
content.items.wild_aura.name: Wild Aura
content.items.wild_aura.description: Slows enemies by 10% within 95 and deals 16 magical damage per second.
content.items.flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
content.items.flamethrower.description: Burns enemies within 85 in a forward 120-degree cone for 25 magical damage per second. Runs for 5 seconds, then cools for 2 seconds.
content.items.trident.name: Trident
content.items.trident.description: Every 7 seconds, throws a returning trident at speed 75 to range 200. It deals 30 physical damage to enemies it pierces.
content.items.magic_projectile.name: Magic Projectile
content.items.magic_projectile.descripti: Fires at a random enemy for 25 magical damage. On a kill it bounces to an enemy within 350.
content.items.soda.name: Soda
content.items.soda.description: Every 3 seconds, leaves a bottle that explodes after 1 second for 15 magical damage in radius 50.
content.items.cane.name: Cane
content.items.cane.description: Basic attacks have a 0.5% chance to execute the enemy with the most health, with a 30-second cooldown. Deals 300 pure damage to bosses.
content.items.rocket.name: Rocket
content.items.rocket.description: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to fire a rocket for 35% of the attack's damage as physical damage.
content.items.electric_gloves.name: Electric Gloves
content.items.electric_gloves.descriptio: Basic attacks have a 20% chance to fire lightning for 25 magical damage. It can bounce up to 4 times.
content.items.dominator_helm.name: Dominator Helm
content.items.dominator_helm.description: Allies within 300 gain 10 percentage points of armor and have a 15% chance to block physical damage.
content.items.welding_mask.name: Welding Mask
content.items.welding_mask.description: 15% chance to block any hit, with a 0.5-second cooldown. Limits vision to a 51-degree cone.
content.items.spiked_boots.name: Spiked Boots
content.items.spiked_boots.description: Allies in radius 300 gain 30 attack speed. Physical hits above 35 damage have a 9% chance to be redirected to the attacker.
content.items.icicle.name: Icicle
content.items.icicle.description: Kills have a 13% chance to trigger a freezing blast for 30 magical damage. The icicle it leaves restores 25% of current health.
content.items.dumbbell.name: Dumbbell
content.items.dumbbell.description: Within 150, allies gain 50 maximum health and summons gain 25.
content.items.blue_cheese.name: Blue Cheese
content.items.blue_cheese.description: Hits have a 33% chance to poison enemies, dealing an additional 6.5% damage as delayed magical damage.
content.items.fan.name: Fan
content.items.fan.description: Gain 20 movement speed. Enemies behind you are slowed by 15%.
content.items.executioner_blade.name: Executioner's Blade
content.items.executioner_blade.descript: Deal 9% more damage to elites and bosses.
content.items.jetpack.name: Jetpack
content.items.shared_heart.name: Shared Heart
content.items.shared_heart.description: Recover 5% of health restored to allies and 4% of health restored to summons.
content.items.motivation_mask.name: Motivation Mask
content.items.motivation_mask.descriptio: Allies within 250 deal 10% more physical damage.
content.items.magnet.name: Magnet
content.items.magnet.description: Every 40 seconds, pulls gold and XP from anywhere in the arena.
content.items.jar_of_wind.name: Jar of Wind
content.items.vampire_hood.name: Vampire Hood
content.items.vampire_hood.description: Allies within 180 gain 8% lifesteal. Extra copies widen the radius by 15%. Several hoods do not add up.
content.items.poor_mans_shield.name: Poor Man's Shield
content.items.poor_mans_shield.descripti: Every 12 seconds, grants a 65-point shield to the ally with the lowest current health.
content.items.sight.name: Sight
content.items.sight.description: Deal 9% more damage to the enemy with the most current health.
content.items.totem.name: Totem
content.items.totem.description: Heals allied summons within 425 for 1 HP per second.
content.items.leaders_heart.name: Leader's Heart
content.items.fb_ring.name: F.B. Ring
content.items.inverted_cross.name: Inverted Cross
content.items.inverted_cross.description: Prevents one death, restores all health, and grants 3.5 seconds of invulnerability. Consumed on use.
content.items.gold_vein_heart.name: Heart of the Gold Vein
content.items.gold_vein_heart.descriptio: Every second chest offers a third reward.
content.items.phantom_mask.name: Phantom Mask
content.items.phantom_mask.description: Kills have a 10% chance to create a copy for 4 seconds. The copy mirrors attacks at 35% damage. Limit one.
content.items.broken_clock.name: Broken Clock
content.items.broken_clock.description: Every 9 seconds, resets one item that is on cooldown.
content.items.devourer_heart.name: Devourer's Heart
content.items.devourer_heart.description: Below 35% health, devours a random non-boss enemy and heals 20% of maximum health. Cooldown 30 seconds.
content.characters.pig.name: Boar
content.characters.pig.passive: Rams enemies for 5% of max HP and knocks them back. After walking for 5 s, gains 25% speed and 10% ram damage. Survives a killing blow as a ghost for 5 s.
content.characters.pig.growth: +0.2 s in ghost form per level.
content.characters.miner.name: Miner
content.characters.miner.passive: Explodes for 15 damage in a radius of 50 per 80 HP lost.
content.characters.necromancer.name: Necromancer
content.characters.necromancer.passive: Kills grant souls and +0.5% damage per soul. Every 30 s, souls summon a healer (1-20), warrior (21-50) or area attacker (51+).
content.characters.vampire.name: Vamp-chan
content.characters.vampire.passive: Heals for 3.65% of the damage dealt. Lifesteal heals in full up to 10% of max HP per second instead of 6%.
content.characters.vampire.growth: +0.25 percentage points of lifesteal per level.
content.characters.puppeteer.name: Puppeteer
content.characters.puppeteer.passive: Allies and allied summons gain 10.5% damage and attack speed.
content.characters.puppeteer.growth: +1 percentage point to both bonuses per level.
content.characters.cybernetic_cube.name: Cybernetic Cube
content.characters.cybernetic_cube.passi: Each level increases a random stat by 1.25-8.25%.
content.characters.cybernetic_cube.growt: +1.25-8.25% to one random stat per level.
content.characters.masochist.name: Masochist
content.characters.masochist.passive: Each percent of missing health grants +0.1 HP/s and +0.5 movement speed.
content.characters.masochist.growth: Each level raises the maximum bonuses by 0.01 HP/s and 0.03 movement speed.
content.characters.diver.name: Diver
content.characters.diver.passive: Fixed movement speed. Distance travelled increases armor.
content.characters.diver.growth: +1 percentage point of damage reflection and +1 HP/s per level.
content.characters.skater.name: Skater
content.characters.skater.passive: Moves 25% faster and leaves a 5 s fire trail that deals 5 damage per second.
content.characters.skater.growth: +1 percentage point of movement speed, +2.75 trail DPS and +0.75 trail radius per level.
content.characters.illusionist.name: Illusionist
content.characters.illusionist.passive: Every 14 s, creates a copy for 8 s with 50% of the hero's HP. Copies draw enemy attention and repeat attacks at 30% damage. Multiple copies can coexist.
content.characters.illusionist.growth: +0.25 percentage points of damage, +0.15 s copy lifetime and -0.1 s cooldown per level.
content.enemies.devourer.name: Devourer
content.enemies.timekeeper.name: Timekeeper
content.enemies.phantom.name: Phantom
content.enemies.prospector.name: Prospector
content.enemies.ancient_cultist.name: Ancient Cultist
content.characters.king_arthur.name: King Arthur
content.characters.king_arthur.passive: Excalibur replaces projectiles with a 350-degree physical slash that knocks enemies back. Base radius 30.
content.items.hookah.name: Hookah
content.items.hookah.description: Mist grants you, allied heroes and summons within 200 another 10 percentage points of magic resistance.
content.items.archmage_cloak.name: Archmage's Cloak
content.items.archmage_cloak.description: Grants another 8 percentage points of magic resistance.
content.characters.succubus.name: Succubus
content.characters.succubus.passive: Every 12 s, charms the nearest ordinary enemy within 225 for 3 s. It attacks enemies for 70% of its normal damage. Bosses are immune.
content.characters.succubus.growth: +0.1 s charm duration and -0.15 s cooldown per level.
content.items.devil_sword.name: Devil Sword
content.items.devil_sword.description: Attacks deal 22% more damage to enemies with negative effects. Does not stack.
content.items.vacuum.name: Vacuum
content.items.vacuum.description: Every 12 seconds, pulls enemies within 300 toward you and stuns them for 2 seconds.
content.items.file.name: File
content.items.file.description: Basic attacks reduce enemy armor by 8 percentage points for 3 seconds. Copies stack. Applies throughout the attack area.
content.items.black_candle.name: Black Candle
content.items.black_candle.description: Negative effects you apply to enemies last 8% longer. Copies stack.
content.items.snowball.name: Snowball
content.items.snowball.description: Basic attacks slow enemies by 4% for 3 seconds. Copies stack. Applies throughout the attack area.
content.items.pill.name: Pill
content.items.pill.description: Doubles the size of basic projectiles and their attack radius. Copies add another base size and radius.
